race.title: StoneX Bullion Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: BASS HUNTER was one of the best British-trained bumper horses last season and judged on his easy win on hurdling debut 4 weeks ago, he's a smart novice in the making. He's very likely to outclass these under a penalty, though expensive point recruit Catchem Black should ensure he doesn't have it all his own way. BASS HUNTER (FR) CATCHEM BLACK (IRE) CASPER CHARLIE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Bass Hunter (2/9), Catchem Black (7/2), Casper Charlie (9/1), Chocks Away (22/1), Sienna Earth (28/1), Orchard (33/1), Killarney (80/1), Savvy Stellar (100/1), Saint Canary Rock (100/1), Alcaraz (100/1), Riseandcall (100/1), Days Of Joy (150/1), Ignite The Spark (200/1), Straight Out (300/1)
